<script>window.HSPLASH=(function(){
const A={"BG1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "BG2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "FR": "data:image/webp;base64,", "BR": "data:image/webp;base64,", "BB": "data:image/webp;base64,", "FI": "data:image/webp;base64,", "MU": "data:image/webp;base64,", "AU": "data:audio/mp4;base64,"};

const W=540,H=1170;let c,x;
const L=s=>new Promise(r=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>r(i);i.src=s});
const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v)),ease=p=>p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;
const rnd=n=>{const s=Math.sin(n*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return s-Math.floor(s)};
let bg1,bg2,fr,bR,bB,fire,MUSH;
const SH=[[45,38.5],[43,42],[44,47],[49,50],[52,53],[46,56.5],[36,60],[25,62.5],[15,65],[11,70],[9,74],[11,78],[15,84],[25,90.5],[40,93]];
const WP=[[100,35],[70,35.2],[55,36.5],...SH,[60,92],[80,90],[88,87],[100,86]];
const P=p=>[p[0]*W/100,p[1]*H/100];
const FALL=.6,SWAP=6.3,PS=7.0,PD=5.0,TT=12.6;
// 10 bombs: [impact time, [x%,y%], color 0=red 1=blue]
const PTS=[[10,48],[82,22],[17,23],[66,64],[27,64],[9,91],[45,22],[52,44],[21,35],[73,85]];
const IMP=PTS.map((p,i)=>[3.75+i*.24,p,i%2]);
const NOSE=2.85;
function poly(pts){x.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>{const q=P(p);i?x.lineTo(q[0],q[1]):x.moveTo(q[0],q[1])});x.closePath()}
function drawWater(t){}
function drawBombs(t){
  IMP.forEach(([ti,[ix,iy],col])=>{
    const a=t-(ti-FALL);if(a<0||a>FALL)return;
    const p=a/FALL,e=p*p;
    const sx=(ix+9)*W/100,sy=-70,tx=ix*W/100,ty=iy*H/100;
    const px=sx+(tx-sx)*e,py=sy+(ty-sy)*e,ang=Math.atan2(ty-sy,tx-sx);
    const im=col?bB:bR,sc=.6;
    x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,210,140,.35)';x.lineWidth=3;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px-(tx-sx)*.07,py-(ty-sy)*.07);x.lineTo(px,py);x.stroke();
    x.save();x.translate(px,py);x.rotate(ang-NOSE);x.drawImage(im,-im.width*sc/2,-im.height*sc/2,im.width*sc,im.height*sc);x.restore();
  });
}
const MA=.5,MB=.925;
function smokeAt(cx,cy,a,seed,sc){
  for(let k=0;k<10;k++){
    const age=clamp((a-k*.06)/2.4);if(age<=0)continue;
    const sy=cy-age*(150*sc)-k*6*sc,sr=(16+age*40+k*2)*sc,sa=.55*(1-age);
    const sx=cx+Math.sin(k*2.3+seed+a*1.2)*(14+age*22)*sc;
    const g=x.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,1,sx,sy,sr);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(55,45,42,'+sa+')');g.addColorStop(.6,'rgba(38,30,28,'+sa*.6+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(25,20,20,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.arc(sx,sy,sr,0,7);x.fill();
  }
}
function drawExplosions(t){
  IMP.forEach(([ti,[ix,iy]],n)=>{
    const a=t-ti;if(a<0||a>4.2)return;
    const cx=ix*W/100,cy=iy*H/100,sc=.5+.9*(iy/100);
    // crater with glowing rim, stays and fades
    const ca=clamp(a/.2)*clamp((4.2-a)/1.4);
    x.save();x.translate(cx,cy+4*sc);x.scale(1,.38);
    let g=x.createRadialGradient(0,0,2,0,0,46*sc);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(15,6,2,'+.95*ca+')');g.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(40,12,3,'+.9*ca+')');g.addColorStop(.8,'rgba(255,110,20,'+.85*ca*(.8+.2*Math.sin(t*14+n))+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,60,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.arc(0,0,46*sc,0,7);x.fill();x.restore();
    // ground shockwave
    if(a<.8){x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,225,170,'+(.75*(1-a/.8))+')';x.lineWidth=5*(1-a/.8)+1;x.beginPath();x.ellipse(cx,cy,130*sc*clamp(a/.8),42*sc*clamp(a/.8),0,0,Math.PI*2);x.stroke()}
    // white flash
    if(a<.16){const fa=1-a/.16,g2=x.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,100*sc);g2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,'+fa+')');g2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,210,140,0)');x.fillStyle=g2;x.beginPath();x.arc(cx,cy,100*sc,0,7);x.fill()}
    // dark smoke rising
    smokeAt(cx,cy,a,n*3.7,sc);
    // mushroom fire cloud: grows from the impact, then fades
    if(a<3.4){
      const p=ease(clamp(a/.9)),sw=(.22+.78*p)*(.11+.09*(iy/100)),sh=(.1+.9*clamp(a/.7))*(.11+.09*(iy/100));
      x.save();x.globalCompositeOperation='screen';x.globalAlpha=clamp((3.4-a)/1.2)*clamp(a/.08);
      x.drawImage(MUSH,cx-MA*1508*sw,cy-MB*940*sh,1508*sw,940*sh);x.restore();
    }
    // embers
    for(let k=0;k<22;k++){
      const ang=-Math.PI/2+(rnd(n*30+k)-.5)*2.4,sp=70+rnd(n*30+k+7)*170,d=sp*a*(1-a*.15),life=1-a/2.4;if(life<=0)continue;
      x.fillStyle='rgba(255,'+(150+rnd(k)*80|0)+',60,'+life+')';
      x.fillRect(cx+Math.cos(ang)*d*.8*sc,cy+Math.sin(ang)*d*sc+a*a*55,2.5,2.5);
    }
  });
}
function shake(t){
  let sx=0,sy=0;
  IMP.forEach(([ti])=>{const a=t-ti;if(a>0&&a<.55){const k=Math.pow(1-a/.55,2)*10;sx+=Math.sin(a*90)*k;sy+=Math.cos(a*77)*k*.7}});
  return [sx,sy];
}
function scene(t){
  const [sx,sy]=shake(t);
  x.save();x.translate(sx,sy);
  x.drawImage(bg1,-12,-12,W+24,H+24);
  const haze=clamp((t-4.5)/1.8)*.4;
  if(haze>0){x.fillStyle='rgba(30,15,10,'+haze+')';x.fillRect(-12,-12,W+24,H+24)}
  if(t>=SWAP){x.globalAlpha=clamp((t-SWAP)/.45);x.drawImage(bg2,-12,-12,W+24,H+24);x.globalAlpha=1}
  if(t>=SWAP-.2){
    const f=.07+.05*Math.sin(t*9)+.03*Math.sin(t*23);
    x.fillStyle='rgba(255,70,0,'+f+')';x.fillRect(-12,-12,W+24,H+24);
    for(let k=0;k<26;k++){const e=(t*.35+rnd(k))%1,ex=rnd(k+50)*W,ey=H*(1-e)*.9;
      x.fillStyle='rgba(255,'+(110+rnd(k)*90|0)+',40,'+(.7*(1-e))+')';x.fillRect(ex+Math.sin(t*3+k)*14,ey,3,3)}
  }
  drawBombs(t);drawExplosions(t);
  x.restore();
  const fl=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(t-(SWAP+.02))/.3);
  if(fl>0){x.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,215,'+fl*.9+')';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}
}
const FW=540,FHt=122,FY0=930,sx_=540/920,sy_=122/380;
function bar(t){
  const t0=6.45,sl=ease(clamp((t-t0)/.5));if(sl<=0)return;
  const FY=FY0+(1-sl)*260;
  x.drawImage(fr,0,FY,FW,FHt);
  const ix0=248*sx_,ix1=672*sx_,iy0=FY+184*sy_,iy1=FY+284*sy_,my=(iy0+iy1)/2,ih=iy1-iy0;
  const prog=clamp((t-PS)/PD),pp=prog;
  const BL=Math.min(ih*3.1,112),bcx=(ix1-BL*.5)-pp*((ix1-BL*.5)-(ix0-BL*.62));
  x.save();x.beginPath();x.rect(ix0,iy0,ix1-ix0,ih);x.clip();
  if(pp>=0&&t>=PS-.05){
    // fire fills the black square: flame base at the bomb, trailing to the right
    x.save();x.beginPath();x.rect(Math.max(ix0,bcx),iy0,ix1-Math.max(ix0,bcx)+2,ih);x.clip();
    for(let k=6;k>=0;k--){
      x.save();x.translate(bcx+BL*.40+k*46,my+Math.sin(t*21+k*2)*.8);x.rotate(Math.PI/2);
      const fw=ih*1.55*(1+.05*Math.sin(t*26+k)),fh=(k?140:280)*(1+.05*Math.sin(t*17+k*3));
      x.globalAlpha=k?.9:1;
      x.drawImage(fire,-fw/2+Math.sin(t*13+k)*1.5,-fh,fw,fh);
      x.restore();
    }
    x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';x.globalAlpha=1;x.restore();
    // bomb (red atomic) pointing left, thickness = bar height so the fire comes out of its whole tail
    const bw=bR.width,bh=bR.height,ext=Math.abs(Math.sin(NOSE-Math.PI))*bw+Math.cos(NOSE-Math.PI)*bh;
    const sc=ih/(Math.hypot(bw,bh)*.62)*2.3;
    x.save();x.translate(bcx,my-3);x.rotate(Math.PI-NOSE);
    x.shadowColor='#ff9a30';x.shadowBlur=8;
    x.drawImage(bR,-bw*sc/2,-bh*sc/2,bw*sc,bh*sc);x.restore();
  }
  x.restore();
  const pct=Math.round(pp*100)+'%';
  x.font='bold 40px Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif';x.textAlign='center';x.lineWidth=7;x.strokeStyle='#2a0a00';x.lineJoin='round';
  const ty=FY+FHt+36;
  x.strokeText(pct,W/2,ty);
  const g2=x.createLinearGradient(0,ty-34,0,ty);g2.addColorStop(0,'#fff0b0');g2.addColorStop(1,'#e0a020');
  x.fillStyle=g2;x.fillText(pct,W/2,ty);
}

function stop(){const cv=document.getElementById('hsCover');if(cv)cv.remove();stopped=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);try{au&&au.pause()}catch(e){}if(ov){ov.remove();ov=null}if(resolveFn){resolveFn();resolveFn=null}}

function run(){

    document.body.append(ov);{const cv=document.getElementById('hsCover');if(cv)cv.remove()}

      tryPlay();
      const unlock=()=>{if(stopped)return;try{au.currentTime=Math.min(TT-.1,(performance.now()-t0)/1000);au.play();hint.style.opacity=0}catch(e){}};
      ov.addEventListener('touchstart',unlock,{once:true});ov.addEventListener('mousedown',unlock,{once:true});
      const loop=()=>{if(stopped)return;const t=(performance.now()-t0)/1000;if(t>=TT&&(window.__dataReady||t>=TT+40)){stop();return}render(Math.min(t,TT-.02));raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)};
      loop();
    });
  });
}
